content.text: Errogon, gimed e gimed be yog lungun e girdi’.
Gimed ra yim’, me mathmit e gonop.
Gadad e ta’reb rogon e tin gadad manang;
dariy ban’en ni gimed ba cheag riy ngog;
go’ yi manang urngin e pin’en ni kamogned.
Mus ngak e pi tafager rog ma ku gu mang bmakak’ar ngorad;
yad be minmin ngog, ni yug aram rogon ni gub mat’aw ni dariy thibngig;
ma immoy bingyal’ nma fulweg Got taban e meybil rog.
Gimed e dawori aw e gafgow ngomed, ma be makakar’anmed ngog;
ra be tuturpel be’ mi gimed thuruy.
Pi’in ma moro’ro’ u fithik’ e yargal nge pi’in dar nanged Got e yad be par u fithik’ e gapas,
ni yug aram rogon ni gelingrad e kemang got rorad.
Bo’or ban’en ni gimed ra fil rok e arche’ nge gamanman;
mu fithed gubin mit e yafos nu arow ngar filed ngomed; nge nig nu maday ngar tamilang niged gimed riy.
Go’ yad manang ni pa’ SOMOL e sunumiyrad.
Gubin ban’en nib fos ma bay u lan pa’ Got;
nge pogofan ko girdi’.
Teliy e ma sikengnag e thin nike rung’ag,
ni bod rogon blothey nma ri’ lamen e ggan.
Gonop nge tamilangan’ e bay rok e pi’in ke ilal,
ya ke n’uw nap’rad.
Ma Got e bay e gonop rok ma ba gel gelngin;
ma ba tanom ma ir e manang.
Ra buthug Got nga but’, ma mini’ e rayag niki toy,
me mini’ e rayag rok ni pag e en Got e ke kalbusnag?
Ra kol Got e n’uw me fengfeng e nam;
me pithig pa’ riy me sugbur e nam.
Got e ba gel ma gubin ngiyal’ nma par nib gel;
en ni kan bannag nge en ke ban e go’ yow bay u tan gelngin.
Ir e ma chuweg e gonop rok e pi tagagiyeg
mma gagiyegnag e pi’in yad ma yog e thin ngu’ur ngongoliyed e ngongol ko balyang.
Ir e ma chuweg e pilung u tagil’rad nge kalbus nagrad;
me sobut’nag e pi prist nge pi’in nib gel gelingrad.
Ma th’abgulungan e pi’in nib pagan’uy ngorad,
mma chuweg e gonop rok e pi’in pi’lal.
Ma dariyfannag e pi’in bay gelingrad
ma moseg gelngin e pi tagagiyeg.
Ma pi’ e tamilang ko yungin nib rimug ni yam’.
Ma gelnag e pi nam nge gilbuguwrad,
ma ir e ma waer nagrad nge thirifrad u but’.
Ma balyangnag e pi’in ma yog e thin rorad
me pagrad ngu’ur derawgad nike minan’rad ma ka ra maloggad;
yad be gorbal u fithik’ e lumor ma yad be thigthig ni bod e chingaw.
